_comment: Copy the relevant block into your client's config file:
Replace <PROJECT_ROOT> with the absolute path to this repo,
and <MCP_SECRET> with the value you set in your .env file.
The stdio transport (mcp_stdio) is recommended for local development.
The HTTP transport (mcp_http) is recommended for production deployments.

smartmart-stdio._comment: Stdio transport — spawns the bridge as a subprocess. Best for local dev.

smartmart-http._comment: HTTP transport — connects to a running SmartMart server. Best for production.
